-- ==============================================================================
-- SILKSTONE GREENS APP V3 - CORE DATABASE MIGRATION SCRIPT
-- Single Source of Truth: System Requirements Specification V3
-- ==============================================================================


-- 1. EXTENSIONS
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";


-- 2. TABLE DEFINITIONS


-- Table 1: team_members
-- Stores personnel profiles and security role flags.
CREATE TABLE public.team_members (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    phone TEXT,
    email TEXT UNIQUE,
    is_leader BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    is_admin BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE
);


-- Table 2: dance_catalog
-- Repository for routines, position formats (8 or 12), and specialized role toggles.
CREATE TABLE public.dance_catalog (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    dance_name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    standard_positions INT NOT NULL CHECK (standard_positions IN (8, 12)),
    has_maf BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    has_mab BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);


-- Table 3: competencies
-- Tracks dancer proficiency per position and musician competency per tune.
-- Universal scale: 'L' (Learner), 'Q' (Qualified), 'M' (Master)
CREATE TABLE public.competencies (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    member_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.team_members(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    dance_name TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.dance_catalog(dance_name) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    position_number INT, -- 1-8 or 1-12, or NULL for general musician competency
    proficiency_level CHAR(1) NOT NULL CHECK (proficiency_level IN ('L', 'Q', 'M')),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    CONSTRAINT unique_member_dance_position UNIQUE (member_id, dance_name, position_number)
);


-- Table 4: booking_set_layouts
-- Maps active dancer and musician allocations per performance set.
CREATE TABLE public.booking_set_layouts (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    booking_id UUID NOT NULL,
    dance_name TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.dance_catalog(dance_name) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    layout_data JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('Go', 'Pending', 'No-go')) DEFAULT 'Pending',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

ALTER TABLE public.booking_set_layouts
    ADD CONSTRAINT unique_booking_set_layout UNIQUE (booking_id, dance_name);


-- Table 5: audit_logs (Required for Section 8 Traceability)
CREATE TABLE public.audit_logs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    user_id UUID,
    action TEXT NOT NULL,
    table_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_id UUID,
    old_data JSONB,
    new_data JSONB,
    timestamp TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);


-- 3. ROW LEVEL SECURITY (RLS) POLICIES


ALTER TABLE public.team_members ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.dance_catalog ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.competencies ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.booking_set_layouts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;


-- Helper Function: Check if authenticated user is a Leader or Admin
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_leader_or_admin()
RETURNS BOOLEAN AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.team_members
    WHERE id = auth.uid() AND (is_leader = TRUE OR is_admin = TRUE)
  );
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;


-- RLS: team_members
-- Members can view names; phone and email are hidden via application queries unless user is Leader/Admin.
CREATE POLICY "Allow read access to authenticated members" 
ON public.team_members FOR SELECT 
TO authenticated 
USING (true);


CREATE POLICY "Allow full access to Leaders and Admins" 
ON public.team_members FOR ALL 
TO authenticated 
USING (public.is_leader_or_admin());


-- RLS: dance_catalog
CREATE POLICY "Allow read access to catalog for all authenticated users" 
ON public.dance_catalog FOR SELECT 
TO authenticated 
USING (true);


CREATE POLICY "Allow Admins to modify catalog" 
ON public.dance_catalog FOR ALL 
TO authenticated 
USING (
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.team_members
    WHERE id = auth.uid() AND is_admin = TRUE
  )
);


-- RLS: competencies
CREATE POLICY "Allow read access to competencies" 
ON public.competencies FOR SELECT 
TO authenticated 
USING (true);


CREATE POLICY "Allow Leaders/Admins to update competencies" 
ON public.competencies FOR ALL 
TO authenticated 
USING (public.is_leader_or_admin());


-- RLS: booking_set_layouts
CREATE POLICY "Allow read access to layouts" 
ON public.booking_set_layouts FOR SELECT 
TO authenticated 
USING (true);


CREATE POLICY "Allow Leaders/Admins to modify layouts" 
ON public.booking_set_layouts FOR ALL 
TO authenticated 
USING (public.is_leader_or_admin());


-- 4. AUDIT LOGGING TRIGGER (Section 8 Requirement)


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_competency_changes()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, table_name, record_id, old_data, new_data)
    VALUES (
        auth.uid(),
        TG_OP,
        TG_TABLE_NAME,
        COALESCE(NEW.id, OLD.id),
        CASE WHEN TG_OP IN ('UPDATE', 'DELETE') THEN to_jsonb(OLD) ELSE NULL END,
        CASE WHEN TG_OP IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') THEN to_jsonb(NEW) ELSE NULL END
    );
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;


CREATE TRIGGER audit_competencies_trigger
AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON public.competencies
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.log_competency_changes();






Supplemental Build


-- ==============================================================================
-- SILKSTONE GREENS APP V3 - SUPPLEMENTARY SCHEMA EXTENSIONS
-- Purpose: Adds Events, RSVPs, and Musician Profiles for 100% SRS V3 Compliance
-- ==============================================================================


-- 1. TABLE: events
-- Tracks practice sessions and live performance bookings
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.events (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (event_type IN ('Practice', 'Booking')),
    event_date TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    location TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('Pending', 'Go', 'No-go')) DEFAULT 'Pending',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);


-- 2. TABLE: event_rsvps
-- Stores member RSVPs (Attending, Not Attending, Maybe) for practices and events
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.event_rsvps (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    member_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.team_members(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    rsvp_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (rsvp_status IN ('Attending', 'Not Attending', 'Maybe')),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    CONSTRAINT unique_event_member_rsvp UNIQUE (event_id, member_id)
);


-- 3. TABLE: musician_profiles
-- Tracks primary instrument assignments for instrumentation constraint validation
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.musician_profiles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    member_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.team_members(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    primary_instrument TEXT NOT NULL, -- e.g., 'Lead Melodeon', 'Drum', 'Accordion'
    is_qualified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    CONSTRAINT unique_member_instrument UNIQUE (member_id, primary_instrument)
);


-- 4. ROW LEVEL SECURITY (RLS) FOR NEW TABLES


ALTER TABLE public.events ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.event_rsvps ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.musician_profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;


-- Read policies (All authenticated members can view schedule & RSVPs)
CREATE POLICY "Allow read access to events" ON public.events FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "Allow read access to RSVPs" ON public.event_rsvps FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "Allow read access to musician profiles" ON public.musician_profiles FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);


-- Write policies
-- Members can insert/update their own RSVPs
CREATE POLICY "Members can manage own RSVP" ON public.event_rsvps 
FOR ALL TO authenticated 
USING (auth.uid() = member_id) 
WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = member_id);


-- Leaders/Admins have full write access to events and musician profiles
CREATE POLICY "Leaders manage events" ON public.events FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (public.is_leader_or_admin());
CREATE POLICY "Leaders manage musician profiles" ON public.musician_profiles FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (public.is_leader_or_admin());


-- 5. AUTOMATIC UPDATED_AT TRIGGER FUNCTION
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_timestamp()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    NEW.updated_at = NOW();
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;


CREATE TRIGGER update_events_timestamp BEFORE UPDATE ON public.events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_timestamp();
CREATE TRIGGER update_rsvps_timestamp BEFORE UPDATE ON public.event_rsvps FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_timestamp();
CREATE TRIGGER update_competencies_timestamp BEFORE UPDATE ON public.competencies FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_timestamp();
CREATE TRIGGER update_layouts_timestamp BEFORE UPDATE ON public.booking_set_layouts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_timestamp();


Access correction for Stage builder




-- 1. Grant usage and select privileges to the anon and authenticated roles
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT ON public.team_members TO anon, authenticated;


-- 2. Ensure RLS allows reading team members (or add a policy if RLS is enabled)
ALTER TABLE public.team_members ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;


-- Drop existing policy if it conflicts, then create a permissive read policy
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow public read access on team_members" ON public.team_members;


CREATE POLICY "Allow public read access on team_members"
ON public.team_members
FOR SELECT
USING (true);


Access correction for competencies 


-- 1. Grant usage and select privileges to anon and authenticated roles
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT ON public.competencies TO anon, authenticated;


-- 2. Ensure RLS allows reading competency records
ALTER TABLE public.competencies ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;


-- Drop existing policy if it conflicts, then create a permissive read policy
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow public read access on competencies" ON public.competencies;


CREATE POLICY "Allow public read access on competencies"
ON public.competencies
FOR SELECT
USING (true);




Create dance assignment table


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.dance_assignments (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    dance_name TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.dance_catalog(dance_name) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    position_number INT NOT NULL,
    member_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.team_members(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT unique_dance_position UNIQUE (dance_name, position_number)
);
ALTER TABLE public.dance_assignments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Allow public access on dance_assignments" ON public.dance_assignments FOR ALL USING (true);
